analysis.title: Klarna Group Plc. (KLAR): 3Q26 Key Takeaways: Shares outperform on reiteration of guidance and strong QTD read
key_insights: GS reiterates Buy on KLAR with a $18 12-month price target. It says shares outperformed after the print because sentiment was negative and investors liked the reiterated guidance and signs that transaction margin trends were modestly ahead of expectations.

The company no longer expects to sell loans to a degree that would trigger an accounting change it had previously expected. GS reads this as KLAR putting more loans on its own balance sheet, which implies stronger revenue and profitability than sharing economics with third-party loan buyers.
Keeping loans on the balance sheet uses KLAR's low-cost funding advantage, according to GS.

GS's bull case is that KLAR has expanded consumer lending with 3-4% contribution profit as a % of volume, alongside its historical BNPL loans at under 1%. This implies structurally higher margins, but the effect is not yet visible because capital and balance sheet limits led KLAR to sell many of these loans.

GS expects a 'snowball' effect as organic earnings improve. More capital creates more balance sheet capacity, which brings more loan production on balance sheet, which creates more earnings. GS says growth coming in lower than expected in 2026 has delayed this thesis.
GS says improving transaction margins is the key for the stock to work.
3Q26 transaction margin was $371mn at a 1.03% margin, below consensus of $446mn and 1.22%. Processing and servicing costs and provisions were above consensus. GMV and revenue were above consensus.

Non-GAAP operating income was $21mn (2% margin) against about $11mn (1% margin) consensus, helped by adjusted operating expenses about 2% ahead of the street. Reported operating income was -$53mn (-5% margin).
4Q26 guidance midpoints are below consensus on revenue (-5.8%) and transaction margin dollars (-4.7%), and roughly in line on GMV (-0.6%) and adjusted operating profit (-0.5%).

GS cut its target multiple to about 10x EV from about 11x, citing lower peer multiples, applied to Q5-Q8 Adjusted Operating Income Less SBC. It lowered 2026 and 2028 Adj OI estimates, raised 2027, and kept the $18 target.
GS lists the key downside risks as underwriting risk, worsening competition, slower than expected BNPL adoption, merchant pressure on MDRs, and less favorable regulation.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Buy and the $18 target. It expects more loans on the balance sheet to lift revenue and profit, and says improving transaction margins is the key for the stock to work. The share price was $14.27, implying 26.1% upside.

earnings_insights: KLAR 3Q26 reported: GMV $36.1bn vs Visible Alpha consensus $35.7bn, up about 10% y/y.
KLAR 3Q26 reported: net revenue $1.01bn. Transaction and Service revenues about $683mn, +3% vs consensus $664mn. Interest income $273mn, +16% vs consensus $236mn.

KLAR 3Q26 reported: transaction margin $371mn, a 1.03% margin, vs consensus $446mn and 1.22%. Costs vs consensus: processing and servicing $255mn vs $242mn, provisions $201mn vs $188mn, funding $182mn vs $179mn.

KLAR 3Q26 reported: non-GAAP operating income $21mn (2% margin) vs about $11mn (1% margin) consensus. Adjusted operating expenses about $350mn, 2% ahead of the street. Reported operating income -$53mn (-5% margin).

KLAR 4Q26 company guidance (forecast): GMV $42.6-$44.6bn (-0.6% vs consensus at midpoint), revenue $1.017-$1.097 (printed as 'mn' in the report, -5.8% vs consensus at midpoint), transaction margin dollars $414-$444mn (-4.7% vs consensus), adjusted operating profit $100-$120mn (-0.5% vs consensus). Guidance assumes EUR 1.120, SEK 0.100, GBP 1.329.

tension_points.bull_case: KLAR has expanded higher-margin consumer lending (3-4% contribution profit as a % of volume). Keeping more loans on balance sheet with low-cost funding should create a snowball of capital, capacity and earnings and structurally higher margins.
tension_points.bear_case: Growth came in lower than expected in 2026 and delayed the thesis. 3Q26 transaction margin of $371mn (1.03%) was below consensus of $446mn (1.22%), and 4Q26 guidance midpoints for revenue and transaction margin dollars are below consensus.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Transaction margins failing to improve, which GS calls the key for the stock to work.
